description: α_EM per-loop '2' obstruction is nome-independent: Hecke channel-swap q↦−q⁻¹ is ℂ-LINEAR (holomorphic), Hodge conjugation is ℂ-ANTI-LINEAR; unification needs an anti-linear real structure R=swap∘conj. Strengthens #3941. scope-(a), auditOnly.

controls.name: swap_additive
controls.detail: swap(a+b) = swap(a)+swap(b) ⇒ swap is a ring homomorphism

assertions.name: swap_is_C_linear
assertions.detail: swap(i·x) = i·swap(x) ⇒ the Hecke channel-swap is ℂ-LINEAR (holomorphic); anti-linear would give −i·swap(x)

assertions.name: conj_is_C_antilinear
assertions.detail: conj(i·w) = −i·conj(w) ⇒ Hodge conjugation (fixing H¹(M,ℝ)) is ℂ-ANTI-LINEAR

assertions.name: linear_ne_antilinear_nome_independent
assertions.detail: swap(i·w)=+i·swap(w) but conj(i·w)=−i·conj(w) ⇒ swap (ℂ-linear) and conj (ℂ-anti-linear) act oppositely on i·w; different analytic TYPE, nome-independent — the #3941 obstruction is INTRINSIC, not a nome artifact

assertions.name: bridge_R_is_antilinear
assertions.detail: R := swap∘conj satisfies R(i·w) = −i·R(w) ⇒ R is ANTI-LINEAR; a unification needs such an anti-linear real structure R with conj = swap ∘ R (the named open input)

verdict: The α_EM per-loop '2' unification obstruction is NOME-INDEPENDENT (scope-(a), exact algebra) — strengthens #3941. The Hecke channel-swap q↦−q⁻¹ (#3936) is an involutive ℚ(q)-automorphism, hence ℂ-LINEAR (holomorphic): swap(i·x)=i·swap(x). Hodge conjugation (the anti-linear involution fixing H¹(M,ℝ), swapping H^{1,0}↔H^{0,1}) is ℂ-ANTI-LINEAR: conj(i·z)=−i·conj(z). A ℂ-linear and a ℂ-anti-linear involution are of different analytic TYPE — no nome/coordinate converts one to the other, so the #3941 obstruction (previously stated under q=e^{2πiτ}) is INTRINSIC, caveat removed. A unification requires an anti-linear real structure R := swap∘conj on the fibre with conj = swap ∘ R; the existence of a compatible R is the precise open input the τ-functor must supply (the fibre-level reality structure of #3936/#3941, now named). Does not derive the unification or exhibit R. No CODATA read; no nome assumed; no fit; no α_k wired; 1/(8π) stays a phase-4 identification.
scope: (a) scope-limited — nome-independent involution-type obstruction; unification stays open (needs anti-linear R)
